{
  "name": "side-pane",
  "version": "0.1.3",
  "description": "Pins the options and open questions Claude asks you to choose from in a side pane, so you never scroll back to find \"option 2\"",
  "author": {
    "name": "Xi Xiao",
    "url": "https://github.com/xixiaofinland"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/xixiaofinland/side-pane",
  "repository": "https://github.com/xixiaofinland/side-pane",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "pane",
    "sidebar",
    "options",
    "choices",
    "decisions",
    "questions",
    "long-conversations",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "autoOpen": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open automatically",
      "description": "Open the pane when Claude first fills it",
      "default": true
    },
    "maxChars": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Maximum length",
      "description": "Longest pane content in characters; longer content is cut",
      "default": 3000
    }
  }
}
